prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Write solution.rs with the public function at module scope; use only the standard library.
Required API: pub fn cap_per_key(keys: &[String], limit: isize) -> Option<Vec<usize>>
Behavior: Reject a negative limit. Otherwise return the original indices of at most the first limit occurrences of each exact key, preserving global input order. A zero limit or empty input succeeds with a non-null empty result.
Visible example: For keys ["a","b","a","a","b"] and limit 2, return indices [0,1,2,4].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code:
use std::collections::HashMap;
pub fn cap_per_key(keys:&[String],limit:isize)->Option<Vec<usize>>{if limit<0{return None}let mut c=HashMap::new();let mut out=Vec::new();for(i,k)in keys.iter().enumerate(){let n=*c.get(k).unwrap_or(&0);if n<limit as usize{out.push(i)}c.insert(k,n+1);}Some(out)}
